items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: Well I was pretty young and I didn't know too much about Steve outside he was a good piano player. And he could sing all kind of risky numbers and different things like that. And he played with P-Rone's band.

ctx.x: And you stayed with George. Yeah I stayed with George. In California. I was going to ask you in particular about some more of the piano players, a lot of the guys I wouldn't know like you didn't because I wasn't there. But Steve Lewis, I know one time some friend of mine talked to you about Steve Lewis. Can you tell us something about him?

Well I was pretty young and I didn't know too much about Steve outside he was a good piano player. And he could sing all kind of risky numbers and different things like that. And he played with P-Rone's band. But I didn't know too much about Steve. I saw him a couple of times. Because they had a contest on the Estora for the best piano player and my little friend that taught me, started me off playing, Bourbon, won the contest from Steve Lewis and Walter Pichon, who were the top piano players in New Orleans at…
